kind: colonial administrative records (VOC letters and memoranda, translated and published by the Government of Madras)
title: The Dutch in Malabar: being a translation of Selections Nos. 1 and 2 (Dutch Records No. 13)
creator: A. Galletti, A. J. van der Burg, P. Groot (Madras Government Press)
gain_loss: VOC officials writing to Batavia lost face by the surrender; they blame an accident (red-hot ball). Internal secret letters, not propaganda, so the date and troop counts are likely honest.

title: The Travancore State Manual, vol. I
creator: V. Nagam Aiya, for the Travancore Government
url: archive.org djvu text of the Google scan (identifier not recorded by the 1 Nov run; saved copy is the evidence)
gain_loss: Written for the Travancore court: gains from a heroic victory story ('completely defeated'). Follows Shungoonny Menon closely.

kind: court history using Malayalam palace and temple accounts
title: A History of Travancore from the Earliest Times
creator: P. Shungoonny Menon (Dewan Peishcar of Travancore)
